guide.title: WuWa VR — quick setup
guide.risk: Unofficial fan mod. Anti-cheat may detect injected code and restrict or permanently ban your account, even for cosmetic use. Kuro Games has not approved this mod. Nobody can guarantee account safety.
guide.extract: Extract the whole ZIP to a normal folder, then open WuWa VR Launcher.exe. Keep the app and python folders beside it. You do not need to install Python.
guide.runtime: Connect your headset and start its software. To use the simulator, close WuWa and the injector, then select Use this package's simulator. Switching the system OpenXR runtime asks for Windows permission and takes effect on the next game launch.
guide.start: Read and accept the risk notice, choose a build, then Apply & launch. Accept Windows permission for injection and press Play in the game launcher. The standalone official launcher is the tested route; Steam/Epic injection remains unverified.
guide.controls: L3 + R3 opens UEVR. L3 + B shows/hides HUD and menus; L3 + A recenters; L3 + Menu shows the shortcut sheet; L3 + LB toggles HUD / mouse mode. Close UEVR settings before using gameplay shortcuts.
guide.recovery: Reset this build restores the supplied profile, with a backup. Restore my settings from before WuWa VR restores your previous setup. To remove the mod, restore your headset runtime and settings, stop the launcher, then delete the extracted folder.
guide.recording: Recording supports SteamVR and the updated OpenXR Simulator. VDXR, desktop and audio capture are not supported. Keep the simulator preview open in Both eyes, side-by-side, with Full render off. A simulator from an older package must be replaced through the runtime button after closing the game.
guide.scope: Launcher controls and this setup guide are translated. Some build descriptions, developer tools and diagnostic errors remain in English. Translations are drafts; this choice does not change the game's or UEVR's language.
guide.support: Free fan project. Tips are optional and do not buy guaranteed updates or ongoing support. Code and feedback: https://github.com/ChronoHaxx/wuwa-vr — optional tips: https://ko-fi.com/chronohax
